body: The `format` check fails on main and on every open PR, because JuliaFormatter would change `docs/dev-guides/.claude/skills/fix-ci/test_compilation.jl`. The files under `docs/dev-guides` are copied from CliMA/DeveloperGuides by the dev-guides sync workflow, so a formatting fix here would be overwritten by the next sync. This PR adds `docs/dev-guides` to `ignore` in `.JuliaFormatter.toml`. With it, `JuliaFormatter.format(".")` makes no changes on main.
title: chore: exclude the vendored dev guides from formatting
